book.name: Markus
book.title: Ramatua Yesus Tutui Malole na tuka Markus susura na

content: Tutui malole ia. Ia nana, Manetualain Ana Na
tutuin. Nade na Yesus Kristus, fo Manetualain tudu memaꞌ Ana neme uluꞌ mai so. Tutuiꞌ a mulai na leo iaꞌ:
Yohanis Mana Saraniꞌ a buka enoꞌ fee Ramatua Yesus

Yesus bei ta noi Ria nonoi-tataon fa, te Manetualain nadenu lahenda esa, nade Yohanis. Yohanis muste neu sadia enoꞌ fee Yesus mamai na. Huu fo nai fai a ulu na Manetualain pake mananesimatan, nade baꞌi Yesaya. Ana duiꞌ memaꞌ nae:

content.text: “Nenene o! Au adenu Au lahenda ki, fo neu soi enoꞌ fee O.
Lahenda ria neuꞌ ko neu nai mamanaꞌ fo lahenda taꞌa na, de naloo-nakou, nae:
‘Basa lahenda ra mahehere ao mara tao matalolole eno-dalaꞌ, fo sipo Ramatuaꞌ a mamai na!
Tao ma enoꞌ a roos a fo sipo-soruꞌ Ana!’ ”

content: Lahenda biasa raloon sona rae Yohanis, Mana Saraniꞌ. Ana leo nai mamana lino-nees. Ria papake na tao neme banda unta a bulu na. Ria tali-ee na tao neme banda rouꞌ. Ria nanaa na, lamaꞌ ma fani oe nura. (Yohanis masoda na, sama leoꞌ fai a ulu na baꞌi Elia.) Tepoꞌ ria, lahenda dodouꞌ reme kota Yerusalem mai, ma propinsi Yudea a isi na katemaꞌ, mai raneta ro Yohanis nai ria mamana na. Ara mai nana nau rita Yohanis ma nau ramanene ria nonori-nafadan. Yohanis nafada si nae, “Emi muste manaku ma foa ela sala mara katemaꞌ, fo ela leoꞌ bea na Manetualain sae-safe heni salaꞌ sira. Basa sona emi muste sarani dei, fo dadi tanda, nae emi malolole mo Manetualain so.” Basa de ara manaku sala nara, boe ma ana sarani si nai lee Yarden a.
Ana nafada, nae, “Neuꞌ ko lahenda esa kahereꞌ lena heni au, sakaꞌ mai. Leo mae dadi adaꞌ noi neuꞌ Ria lahenda nadedenun boe oo, au ta araa fa.
Au bisa sarani emi uniꞌ adaꞌ noi oe, tehuu neuꞌ ko Ria tao lena au, huu fo Ana tao nahenu emi dale mara neniꞌ Manetualain Dula-dale Malalao-malalafu Na.”
Yohanis sarani Ramatua Yesus
Tepoꞌ ria, Yesus nemeꞌ koro Nasaret nai propinsi Galilea, mai naneta no Yohanis. Boe ma Yohanis sarani Ni nai lee Yarden.
Faiꞌ fo Yesus kalua nemeꞌ oe daleꞌ mai, kekeneu te, lalai natahuꞌa. Boe ma Manetualain Dula-dale Na onda neuꞌ Ana, sama leoꞌ manupui kalasi.
Boe ma ramanene Manetualain haraoe Na nemeꞌ lalai mai nae,

content.text: “O ia nana Au ana susue ka.
O tao ma Au amahoꞌo laꞌo naroo.”

content: Nitu ra Malaka na soba Yesus nai mamana lino-nees
Basa ria boe ma, Manetualain Dula-dale Na hela noo Yesus leo mamana lino-nees a neu.

Banda fuiꞌ ara rai naa. Yesus leo nai mamanaꞌ ria faiꞌ haa hulu. Nai na, nitu ra malaka na mai soba neuꞌ Yesus ela tuka ni, tehuu ta nalan fa. Basa boe ma, Manetualain eilaꞌo-limalopen reme nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a mai rafaduli neuꞌ Ana.
Ramatua Yesus leo Galilea neu fo natudu Manetualain eno Na
Tepoꞌ fo, ara ena Yohanis Mana Saraniꞌ a nai bui daleꞌ, boe ma Yesus leo propinsi Galilea neu, fo nafada Manetualain Tutui Malole Na.
Ana dedea nae,

content.text: “Nenene, o! Besaꞌ ia Manetualain ledo-fain losa so!
Besaꞌ ia basa lahenda ra bubuluꞌ rae, Manetualain homu pareta.
Huu ria na, de emi muste hahae memeꞌ mapuputa mara mai leo,
Basa sona, mamahere neuꞌ Ria Tutui Malolen ia, leo.”

content: Ramatua Yesus naloo manadolu-manadala ra fo tuka Ni
Faiꞌ esa boe ma Yesus laꞌo tuka dano Galilea suu na. Ana nita lahenda esa, nade Simon no fadi na, nade Anderias. Dua si dala ikaꞌ. Huu fo sira dua nonoi bale fain ria.
Yesus naloo si nae, “Ae! Mai fo tuka Au leo! Emi biasa saka ikaꞌ, tehuu besaꞌ ia Au nau tao fee emi dadi manasaka sumaneꞌ.”
Ramanene leoꞌ na boe ma dua si foa ela dala ria, de reu tuka tutiꞌ Ana.
Basa ria de, Yesus laꞌo naroo seluꞌ baiꞌ, boe ma Ana nita Sabadeus ana nara. Aꞌa na nade Yakobis, ma fadi na nade Yohanis. Dua si rahii pukaꞌ nai ofaꞌ daleꞌ.
Yesus naloo dua si nae, “Ae! Mai fo tuka Au!” De, dua si foa ela papa na, no lahenda mana noi ra nai ofaꞌ lain. Boe ma reu tuka Ni.
Ramatua Yesus usi heni nitu neme lahenda esa mai nai kota Kapernaum
Basa boe ma, Yesus no lahenda kahaaꞌ fo riꞌ tuka Ni a, losa kota Kapernaum. Tepoꞌ fo lahenda Yahudi ra fai huhule-haradoin,
boe ma Yesus leo uma mamasoꞌ daleꞌ neu, fo nanori-nafada nai na.
Ramanene dedea Na, basa lahenda ra roi ramakokoaꞌ a, huu fo Ana nalelaꞌ matetuꞌ nanoriꞌ ria isi na. Ta sama no lahenda Yahudi ra mese agama nara fa.
Faiꞌ ria hapu lahenda esa nitu ra heke ran. Ana tuka leo uma mamasoꞌ dale neu boe, basa de nitu fo nai lahenda ria daleꞌ a nahara nae,

“Ae! Yesus lahenda Nasaret! O manuu nafaduliꞌ ubeaꞌ moo ami? O mai fo nau tao malutu ami, do? Ami malelaꞌ O. Lahenda fo Manetualain helu feen mai. O ia nana, Manetualain Lahenda Malalao-malalafun, ta nanuu salaꞌ fa!”
Tehuu Yesus nasapaa ni nae, “Maꞌauꞌ bafa ma! Kalua meme lahenda ria mai!”
Nitu a tao na lahenda ria hede-hede mesan. Boe ma ana kalua neme lahenda ria mai, ma kasi namberaina.

Boe ma, basa lahenda rai uma mamasoꞌ ria daleꞌ, roi ramakokoaꞌ a. Ara bai dea rae, “Ae! Ubea ia, e? Ana pareta nitu ra fo kalua, boe ma tuka Ria hihii-nanaun. Nanori bebeuꞌ ia, do? Tou lasiꞌ a dedea na kahereꞌ, ó!”
Boe ma lahenda ra mulai ratui ao, neme bafaꞌ mai leo bafaꞌ neu, losaꞌ rule-feo nai propinsi Galilea.
Ramatua Yesus puli na Petrus arina na, ma lahenda dodouꞌ
Tepoꞌ fo ara reme uma mamasoꞌ ria mai, boe ma Yesus leo Simon no Anderias uma na neu. Yakobis no Yohanis sama-sama roo si.
Simon arina na namahedi ao lumaiꞌ, de napeuꞌ nai koi lain. De, tepoꞌ fo Yesus no ana mana tuka dea nara kodi leo uma ria daleꞌ reu, boe ma lahenda mai rafadan rae, “Inalasiꞌ a namahedi ao lumaiꞌ.”
Yesus neu dama inalasiꞌ a, boe ma tai na lima na, fo bifi nafoan. Boe ma ao lumai na mopoꞌ ana. Basa boe ma, inalasiꞌ a kalua neu nalalau si.
Ledo a sakaꞌ tena boe ma, lahenda ra roo sira lahenda kamahedi nara, ma lahenda nitu heke nara. Ara roo si leo Yesus mai fo hule tutulu-fafaliꞌ.
Losaꞌ kota esa lahenda nara mai, de tesa rai uma ria matan.
Lahenda sira hedi nara rupaꞌ ara, tehuu Yesus puli na basa si. Ma usi heni nitu makaresiꞌ dodou-inaꞌ. Tehuu Ana ta fee nitu sira lelaꞌ fo dedea fa, huu fo ara ralelaꞌ Ana.
Ramatua Yesus nafeo nai kota fekeꞌ ara, fo nafada Manetualain Tutui Malole Na
Balahaꞌ dulupila na, bei maꞌiuanaꞌ, te Yesus foa de kalua neme uma ria mai so. Ana leo mamana lino-nees esa neu fo hule-haradoi, dedea no Manetualain.
Tepoꞌ fo Simon asa foa, te ara ta rita Yesus fa, boe ma reu saka Ni.
Faiꞌ fo ara raneta roo Ni boe ma rae, “Papa, lahenda dodouꞌ saka Papa ka.”
Tehuu Ana sipoꞌ asa nae, “Ria malole a boe. Tehuu malole lenaꞌ ita leo koro fekeꞌ fo raneneaꞌ nai baianaꞌ ia dei. Huu fo Au nau afada si Tutui Malole a boe. Huu fo nana Au nonoi ki ria.”
Basa boe ma, Ana laꞌo nafeo propinsi Galilea a, fo tui-nafada Tutui Malole neme Manetualain mai nai sira uma mamaso nara. Ma Ana usi heni nitu ra remeꞌ lahenda ra mai boe.
Ramatua Yesus puli na lahenda kamahedi kusta esa

Tepoꞌ ria, hapu lahenda kamahedi kusta esa leo Yesus mai. Boe ma ana sundaꞌ undulaka na, fo hule neuꞌ Yesus nae, “Papa, é! Fali ma au dei! Huu fo au bubuluꞌ, Papa bisa tao mamopo hedi ki ia, ela leoꞌ bea na lahenda bosoꞌ rahiaꞌ au bali. Sadi Papa nau.”
Yesus kasian neuꞌ lahenda ria, boe ma Ana looꞌ lima Na neu, de nafaroe ni, ma nae, “Memaꞌ, Au nau! Naa, o malole leo.”
Kekeneu te, lahenda ria hedi na mopoꞌ ana.
Boe ma Yesus nadenu lahenda ria fali neun, tehuu feen nafarerene,

nae, “Mafarereneꞌ matalolole! O teꞌe ma aom so, tehuu ta bole mafada lahenda esa boeꞌ, e! O muste tuka baꞌi Musa pareta na dei. De, leo malaka agama ra muu, fo ana parisaꞌ o ao-ina ma, ela nita o hedi ma mopon matetuꞌ, do taꞌa! Basa sona, o muste fee tutunu-hohotuꞌ tanda makasi, ela basa lahenda ra bubuluꞌ rae, o teꞌe matetuꞌ so.”

Tehuu lahenda ria nala deaꞌ boe ma ana neu tui nafeo basa mamanaꞌ ara. Boe ma lahenda dodouꞌ saka Yesus fo nau raneta Roon, losaꞌ Ana ta bisa natudu mata-idun nai kota dale fa. De, Ana leo nahaniꞌ mamana lino-nees nai kota a deaꞌ. Tehuu sudi neme mamanaꞌ ain mai, lahenda roi faa-faaꞌ a mai, fo nau raneta roo Ni.

footnotes.text: Dedeaꞌ nae ‘Mantualain Ana Na’ neꞌes ana duduiꞌ teaꞌ ruma.

Dudui dedea Yunani tea na nae, “naloe aon fo sefi sopatu na tali na boe oo, au ta araa fa.” Sosoa na nae, Yohanis nana lahenda aanaꞌ, de leo mae ana dadi neuꞌ Ramatua Yesus lahenda nadedenun boe oo, ana ta naraa fa.
Lahenda Yahudiꞌ ra fai huhule-haradoin, fai hahae aon, do fai hahae aoꞌ, ara rae ‘Fai Sabat’.
